source_snapshot.items: Updated Gen4 PCIe switch firmware will activate on AC cycle
source_snapshot.procedure: Generic DGX bundle upload to HGX_0 then AC cycle.

old_problem: The Gen4 switch, fan-out ports, image/versions and recovery are not identified behind HGX_0.
disposition_reason: PCIe switch identity and every downstream path are core flash/recovery semantics that generic Redfish cannot supply.
decision_basis: Preserved switch-specific flash, AC activation and per-port coverage.

test_case.test_name: Gen4 PCIe switch firmware AC activation
test_case.purpose: Update the exact Gen4 switch, activate it by approved AC cycle and prove every fan-out port/device returns healthy.
required_package: Switch inventory/serial and complete fan-out map
test_case.test_command: After approval, capture switch/port baseline, submit the scoped image, preserve task status, perform authorized AC cycle and compare every downstream device/link/error counter.
test_case.expected_result: Switch reaches target firmware and all mapped ports/devices restore expected speed/width without new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: A generic HGX task/version cannot prove the switch fan-out.
test_case.recovery: Stop after task/link failure and use the approved switch rollback/OOB recovery.

source_conflict.reason: One HGX_0 target does not define the named Gen4 switch/fan-out.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Supply switch/fan-out mapping, image/versions, port oracle and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: Signed switch flash and fan-out recovery contract.

project_authority: Switch inventory and fan-out are OEM topology data.
